nodes.name: Ball milling and Calcination
nodes.procedure: Taking the sample Ni0.2Mg0.2Cu0.2Zn0.2Co0.2Cr2O4 as an example, 0.5 mmol C4H14NiO8, 0.5 mmol C4H6MgO4, 0.5 mmol C4H6CuO4, 0.5 mmol C4H6O4Zn, 0.5 mmol C4H14CoO8, and 5 mmol C6H9CrO6 were added into an 80 mL stainless pot, sealed with 4 big stainless balls (diameter: 2 cm) and 12 small stainless balls (diameter: 1 cm). Then, the loaded pot was equipped with the high-speed vibrating ball miller (MSK-SFM-3, Hefei MTI Co., Ltd.) and operated for 30 min. The ball-ground powder was scraped off and calcined at 550 °C for 2 h in air at a heating rate of 5 °C min−1.

nodes.name: Catalyst Extrusion
nodes.procedure: 6.5 g of catalyst powder, 10 g of pseudoboehmite, and 8.5 g of glycerol were mixed and then added into the extruder, thus getting the cylindrical product with 5 mm diameter, which was cut into 5 mm pieces. After aging at room temperature overnight, the extruded pieces were calcined in air at 550 C for 2 h; the heating rate was 2 C min−1.
